title: Ransom

scenario.title: A seed is a promise
scenario.body: --seed 1 must give the same note every time, in every Python, including the one in this page. Swap random.choice for random.random() < 0.5 and the note still looks random, but every seeded test breaks. Then the text gets international: 'ß'.upper() is 'SS', and the note must not grow.

character.name: Whiskers
character.role: a cat who writes ransom notes

tagline: Whiskers wants treats. Type a demand, pick a lucky number, and Whiskers cuts it into a ransom note. Same lucky number, same note. Every time.

brain_blurbs.book: Flips a coin for every letter.
brain_blurbs.real: Flips a coin too, but never lets a letter turn into two.
